subject: Re: Kickoff: AutoML-Zero as an internal algorithm-discovery tool
body:
Anders,

Resourcing for the evaluation phase:

- Freya 60% (research lead), Katya 40% (search analysis), Oyin 50% (distributed search infra), Paloma 30% (experiment tooling).
- Compute: evolutionary search is embarrassingly parallel and CPU-dominant, so our main ask is not GPUs - it's a standing pool of ~4,000 preemptible CPU cores. GPU needs are just evaluation of discovered algorithms, covered by titan-a100 best-effort.
- I am NOT requesting a Vulcan reservation for this project; want that on record since the reservation queue is a mess this quarter.

Budget note: preemptible CPU at that scale is roughly $28k/month at internal rates for the ~6 weeks of active search. That's inside my discretionary line, but flagging in case the H2 graduation happens and we 10x it.

Jelena
